subject.title: [Bug]: Google Chat: Space/Group messages silently ignored (DMs work correctly)

question: Should this remain open as the narrow Google Chat mentioned-Space session bug until maintainers have live proof for `requireMention:true` plus `botUser`, or should it be consolidated into broader Google Chat Space/thread routing work?
rationale: Source proves the classifier fix is present and the mention gate can still skip before session creation, but deciding whether the remaining report is a live mention-metadata bug or a broader routing consolidation needs maintainer proof judgment.

options.title: Keep Narrow Live-Repro Bug
options.body: Keep this issue open for a live Google Chat payload/probe and a focused fix to mention detection or diagnostics if `USER_MENTION` metadata is still missed.

options.title: Consolidate Into Broader Space Work
options.body: Move the remaining Space reliability discussion to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/44347 if maintainers want one canonical Google Chat Space-routing umbrella.

options.title: Close After Positive Live Proof
options.body: Close only if a current-main or released build is shown to create `googlechat:group:<spaceId>` sessions and replies with `requireMention:true` and a configured `botUser`.

recommendation.title: Keep Narrow Live-Repro Bug
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a live Google Chat payload/probe and a focused fix to mention detection or diagnostics if `USER_MENTION` metadata is still missed.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history in the mention-policy and Google Chat access path that decides whether this should stay narrow or consolidate.
